paragraphs.text: Saryth was a human warlock from Kessig , Innistrad .

When the Dawnhart Coven first reformed, the leader Katilda was at odds with the young acolyte Saryth. Saryth, a powerful hedgewitch , believed that Ghrin-Danu 's power was not enough to restore Innistrad. She expressed a desire to worship additional gods , but the other witches were unflinching in their loyalty. Whether she was expelled from the coven or left on her own depends on who you ask. Saryth decided to found her coven, one dedicated to a forgotten snake god of venom and vengeance. Whether she intends to interfere with the Dawnhart's Harvesttide rituals or continue to scheme quietly remains to be seen.

Saryth controlled Sinnia , Leinore 's younger sister, through a mask. She intended to summon a creature called the Coiled One (a massive snake -like god ) to chase away the growing darkness in Innistrad. For this she made Sinnia attract people to be sacrificed in the forest. The final part of the ritual would be Sinnia's death, but she was saved by Leinore and Katilda and so the ritual was interrupted. During the fight with Katilda, Saryth fell into a hole that was made by the ritual, to her supposed death.
